entry.name: chooser
entry.digest: Display a scrolling list of selectable items
entry.description: The chooser object is similar to the umenu object, but it displays a scrolling list of selectable items rather than a pop-up menu.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autopopulate
attributes.description: When theattribute is enabled, theobject updates its item list whenever theattribute is set with a path or theorattributes are set with a database query. Whenis disabled, changing the object's current folder or file query has no effect on the item list. However, if you enableafter changing the,, orattributes, the item list will immediately update.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of one of theobject's rows in RGBA format. The other row background color is set by theattribute.

attributes.name: collection
attributes.description: When theattribute is set to a collection name, the item list will be populated with the names of files contained in the named collection. You can define a collection of files using the.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: If the value ofis 0, only the files contained in the folder specified bywill be added to the item list. Ifis greater than zero, then items in subfolders of thefolder will be added to the list, with the folder names(s) prepended to them. Items in subfolders up to the level specified by theattribute are included.

attributes.name: enabledrag
attributes.description: When theattribute is enabled, you can drag a named file item in the list to any Max object that accepts it (such as a).

attributes.name: factorycontent
attributes.description: When theattribute is enabled, files added to the chooser via the use of theorquery will include example files that ship with the Max application.

attributes.name: filekind
attributes.description: Theattribute permits you to build a list ofitems containing all files of a specified type currently present in Max's search path. In order for the filenames to appear, theattribute must be enabled.

attributes.name: filtertext
attributes.description: Theattribute defines a text filter that modifies the list populated by the,, orattributes. Only files that contain the text inwill be included in theobject's list. Whenis empty, no filtering occurs.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: headerheight
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the height of theobject's header in pixels. By default the height is zero and the header is not shown.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Theattribute is used by the inspector to set the text of all the items in the list after you edit them. However, when changing this attribute with a message, you can only set the first item, so we recommend using amessage followed by a series ofmessages to set a list of multiple items.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: keynavigate
attributes.description: Theattribute enables/disables letter key search navigation for. When enabled (1) and theobject is selected, pressing a letter on your keyboard will causeto select the item that begins with that letter. When disabled, key search navigation does not work. Disabling this attribute can be useful if you are using other key commands in your patch, such as with theobject.

attributes.name: margin
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the left and right text margins used when drawing the item text. When theattribute is 0, the object draws the text using a default margin equal to 80% of the currently used font's height.

attributes.name: multiselect
attributes.description: Whenis enabled, theobject permits a user to select more than one item at a time by shift-clicking or command / control clicking. In addition, theattribute modifies how theobject sends selected items out its outlets. The first and third item index outlets will send the messagefollowed by a list of one or more indices for each of the selected items. The second and fourth item contents outlets send the messagefollowed by a list of one or more symbols with the contents of each of the selected items.

attributes.name: parameter_enable
attributes.description: Enables use of this object withand allows forin the Max environment.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Theattribute specifies a file path that will be used to populate the list of items. A file will be included in the list if its name contains the text of the current value of theattribute and its type is included in the types specified by theattribute. In addition theattribute controls whether files contained within any subfolders of thefolder are listed. In order for the contents of the folder designated byset the item list, theattribute must be enabled.

attributes.name: prefix_mode
attributes.description: Theattribute controls how theobject outputs the path location of a chosen filename when usingto list the contents of a folder.

choices.label: The file name is combined with its containing folder name to create a single complete path name.
The containing folder name is output as a separate symbol followed by the file name. This prefix mode cannot be used whenis enabled.
Only the file name is output.

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: preview
attributes.description: When theattribute is enabled, theobject shows a play button the to left of each item. If you connect the fifth outlet ofto an object that can play the type of file displayed in the list (,, or, clicking the play button next to an item will send commands to the connected object to begin playing the file specified by the item.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: selectedclick
attributes.description: When selectedclick is enabled, clicking on an already selected item reports that item. Otherwise items are only reported when the selection changes.

attributes.name: selectioncolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of theobject's currently selected item in RGBA format. A custom background color for the selected item is only displayed if theattribute is enabled.

attributes.name: showdotfiles
attributes.description: Toggles the display of a any files whose names begin with a dot (period). The display of these files is normally supressed.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: stripecolor
attributes.description: Sets the second (alternating) background row color in RGBA format. The other row background color is set by theattribute.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Sets the style to be used for theobject's visual display.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.description: Sets the text color of theobject in RGBA format.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: Theattribute is used in conjunciton with theattribute. It permits filtering files contained in thefolder according to one or more types. The types are four-character type codes as those used by theobject such as AIFF, WAVE, TEXT, and JSON.

attributes.name: useselectioncolor
attributes.description: Toggles the use of theattribute to define a custom selection color.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: A single-click on an item selects the item, causing its contents to be sent out the second outlet and its index to be sent out the left outlet. A double-click on an item sends its contents out the fourth outlet and its item index out the third outlet.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: If theobject contains an item whose contents matches the message, that item will be selected. Then the item's contents will be sent out the second outlet and its index will be sent out the left outlet. If there is no match, the currently selected item is not changed and no output occurs.

messages.name: append
messages.description: The word, followed by any message, appends that message to the end of theobject's item list.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the contents of the currently selected item out the second outlet and the index of the currently selected out the left outlet.

messages.name: count
messages.description: Sends the number of items currently in the item list out the right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: delete
messages.description: The word, followed by one or more item numbers, removes the numbered items from the item list.

messages.name: deselect
messages.description: The wordremoves the visual reprepesentation of the selected item from the chooser object. It does not change the chooser object's current value, so a bang will still output the last selected item.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.digest: Set the items forwith a dictionary
messages.description: The word, followed by a dictionary name, will set the items for. You can also attach the first outlet of aobject to the first inlet of. In order for this to work, the dictionary needs to include an "items" entry. For example, the following dictionary entry will populatewith the items "hank, carol, andreas, roland":"items" : [ "hank", "carol", "andreas", "roland" ]

messages.name: float
messages.description: Sets the currently selected item to the specified index, then sends that item's contents out the second outlet and its index out the left outlet.

messages.name: insert
messages.description: The word, followed by an index number and a message, inserts a new item to the list at the position specified by the index.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Sets the currently selected item to the specified index, then sends that item's contents out the second outlet and its index out the left outlet.

messages.name: next
messages.description: Themessage selects the next item in the list, then sends the selected item's contents out the second outlet and its index out the left outlet.

messages.name: play
messages.description: The word, followed by an index number, sends a command to an object (such asor) connected to the fifth outlet to open and play the specified media file. The index argument selects the file to play.

messages.name: prev
messages.description: Themessage selects the previous item in the list, then sends the selected item's contents out the second outlet and its index out the left outlet.

messages.name: progress
messages.description: When theattribute is on, the word, followed by a float between 0.0 and 1.0, will update the display of the current preview progress circle.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the currently selected item to the specified index, but does not produce any output.

messages.name: setnext
messages.digest: Selects the next item without output
messages.description: Selects the item below the currently selected item in the list, but does not produce any output.

messages.name: setprev
messages.digest: Selects the previous item without output
messages.description: Selects the item above the currently selected item in the list, but does not produce any output.

messages.name: sort
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a positive number, sorts theobject's items alphetically in ascending order (A-Z).followed by a negative number sorts the list of items alphabetically in descending order (Z - A).

messages.name: stop
messages.description: The wordcauses the current preview playback of any item to stop.

outlets.description: The index of the list item received as a message or the item chosen by a single mouse click.
The text of the item received as a message or the item chosen by a single mouse click.
The index of the item chosen by a double mouse click.
The text of the item chosen by a double mouse click.
Connect this inlet to the left inlet of an,,,, orobject to control these objects to play files whenis enabled.
